capabilities.linux: Live magic reader on event

capabilities.contract: Zero, unlimited and overflow timing behavior
capabilities.windows: Nonpositive constant fallback2s
capabilities.macos: No explicit unlimited preset established. Raw menu overflow text1e309 is accepted, persists +inf and survives reload, then breaks second editor callback; direct fractional setter persists zero, while fractional menu input rejects zero. Infinity arming accepts in recorded owner.
capabilities.linux: No same user setting; registry default positive
capabilities.basis: No supported unlimited preset contract is established; absence of an explicit preset does not exclude raw free-text overflow. Real private persistence and editor failure are confirmed under original owners/declared native ports. Historical TODO wording is not a current product contract.

capabilities.basis: Actual shared Lua policy/Unicode and actual macOS state owner, or actual declaration/model guard where named. AHK relationships are source-only. No native event adapter, keyboard or receiving application is certified.

capabilities.contract: Preserve completing control chord identity
capabilities.windows: Named Backspace/Enter/Delete replay loses original modifier attribution; actual native admission and receiving unmeasured.
capabilities.macos: Controls spend through original callback; Cmd shortcuts retain activation. Modified control receiving is not fully certified.
capabilities.linux: Ctrl+Enter spends before shortcut lookup; Ctrl+A retains. Original ports only.
capabilities.basis: Conditional Windows source root; do not infer duplicate delivery or treat a named-control producer as native receiving.

capabilities.contract: First title under CapsLock and held Shift
capabilities.windows: Captured scalar/title send route; equivalent native receiving combination unexecuted.
capabilities.macos: Original callback spends title A but retains lowercase a under shipped-layout translation port.
capabilities.linux: Original public owners emit aB; inverse plan ignores live CapsLock; both Shift sides covered.
capabilities.basis: Two OS-scoped roots share a live-state planning limitation; recording ports qualify both; no physical application proof.

capabilities.contract: Keep first-key repeats and input channel ownership
capabilities.windows: Scalar capture and retirement source checked; native repeat receiving unexecuted.
capabilities.macos: Original callback repeat/release gives AAa; fresh overlapping keys give Abc.
capabilities.linux: Ordinary physical tap first-letter repeat is refused by original broker and retires channel; no-repeat control healthy.
capabilities.basis: Linux Reader/Hook/broker/Writer retirement is observed before teardown; no real evdev/uinput or native stuck-key claim. Additional enabled-shipped-preset control retains actual production declarations and empty valid config.toml; Lua5.4/LuaJIT reproduce the same failure without an unavailable declaration override.

capabilities.contract: Accepted editable timing values belong to consumer numeric domains
capabilities.windows: Shared constant with finite fallback; no matching end-user timeout setter/menu API established in this bounded scope.
capabilities.macos: Positive-fraction/NaN setter values violate arming domain. Original menu overflow 1e309 or finite 1e20 persists through real private Config/TOML and reload, then second editor callback raises at %d; both enabled states. Ordinary fractional menu 0.9 remains rejected.
capabilities.linux: Shared timing registry value; no matching end-user timeout setter/menu API established in this bounded scope.
capabilities.basis: Same OSM-002 validation root. Latest original menu/setter/real Config save/reload/reopen is linked in one process and writes actual private Linux bytes; native filesystem metadata, lease, dialog and regeneration remain ports. No native UI/app crash claim. Platform API absence describes the matching editable interface, not absence of one-shot Shift.

capabilities.contract: Shortcut and nonspending controls retain activation
capabilities.windows: Tab/Escape representation and modified native receiving not measured.
capabilities.macos: Cmd shortcut retains; Backspace/Enter/Tab/Escape spend; arrows/function keys retain in original callbacks.
capabilities.linux: Ctrl+A retains; Ctrl+Enter and five editing controls spend; arrows retain.
capabilities.basis: Control classification precedes shortcut lookup; no proven Mac/Linux Ctrl-control divergence and no claim of complete native control parity.

capabilities.contract: Pause, stop and stale ownership retire activation safely
capabilities.windows: Exact-token settlement, failed-cleanup owner retention and suspend guards checked from source only.
capabilities.macos: Pause disarms/refuses, resume remains plain; complete stop/outage reset owner; disarm preserves release debt intentionally.
capabilities.linux: Ordinary original-channel pause/resume/reload/stop clear arm; reload replaces Engine; guarded stale/partial ACK cases are separate owner invariants.
capabilities.basis: Mechanisms differ by ownership model. Source/declared-port checks do not certify native scheduling, receiving or cost.

capabilities.contract: Generated output informs adjacent CapsWord owner
capabilities.windows: OneShotShift itself does not cancel CapsWord; nearby cancellation belongs to ToggleCapsLock.
capabilities.macos: Direct punctuation serializer call lacks explicit CapsWord relay; combined serializer/watcher and native ordering unresolved.
capabilities.linux: Physical CapsLock cases characterize downstream lock; actual CapsWord activation plus one-shot receiving not executed.
capabilities.basis: Unresolved cross-owner candidate, excluded from confirmed finding count; no common automatic cancellation contract is invented.

capabilities.contract: Physical trigger paths retain OS-specific semantics
capabilities.windows: LAlt producer captures immediately then bounded Shift hold; RCtrl distinguishes tap and long Shift hold.
capabilities.macos: Recommended right Option plus sentinel/control route; sticky_shift calls dedicated Keymap arm, compound sticky actions use a separate owner.
capabilities.linux: RightCtrl standalone tap arms one-shot; canonical key-combination declarations reject one_shot_shift, independent of implemented physical tap route.
capabilities.basis: Documented platform/default namespaces and distinct producer source contracts; generic-action exclusion does not remove tap-hold implementation.
